arguments.title: Show human-reviewed labels instead of needs-eyes prompts
arguments.body:
Coverage currently marks unreviewed rows as `needs eyes` and leaves terminal-reviewed rows unlabeled. Reverse that presentation: current terminal-confirmed reviews show `human-reviewed`, while rows without one have no human-review label. The PR summary uses a `human-reviewed` section and describes chat verdicts neutrally.

Human-review criteria are unchanged: extracted chat verdicts and declared human actors do not qualify until confirmed at a terminal. Superseded or outdated reviews do not qualify. Verdicts, evidence, and the existing JSON review provenance remain available.

Validation: four focused tests passed for terminal-only labeling and superseded reviews, chat extraction and terminal confirmation, PR summaries, and outdated-check handling. Documentation updated.
